scientific_role.purpose: test whether explicit local-coarse-global residual modeling repairs the coherent low-frequency qy bias that caused the locked MV9 primary-condition failure
scientific_role.observed_MV9_primary_result: Mamba repaired qx but both neural architectures remained worse than Raw_B10 for qy at kn0p1_u400; the qy error was broad and sign-coherent rather than pixelwise noise
scientific_role.old_evaluation_role: legacy diagnostic for deciding whether a new prospectively locked fresh-seed confirmation is scientifically justified

not_claimed: first neural denoising of Monte Carlo fields
first denoising particle method for rarefied flow
novelty based only on the local-coarse-global CNN architecture
closest_disclosed_work: Lehtinen et al., Noise2Noise, ICML 2018, DOI/arXiv 10.48550/arXiv.1803.04189
Wei et al., physics-informed noise-assisted self-supervised hypersonic DSMC denoising, Acta Astronautica 241 (2026), DOI 10.1016/j.actaastro.2025.12.056
Yang et al., denoising multiscale particle method, Journal of Computational Physics 537 (2025) 114096, DOI 10.1016/j.jcp.2025.114096
Tatsios et al., DSMC-CFD coupling with Bayesian surrogate modelling, Journal of Computational Physics 520 (2025) 113500, DOI 10.1016/j.jcp.2024.113500
prior_art_boundary.candidate_contribution_if_fresh_confirma: an end-to-end fail-closed DSMC sampling-budget reduction framework for additive second- and third-order kinetic moments, combining exact checkpoint reconstruction and provenance/PSD/additivity audits with independent-seed noisy targets, component-specific low-frequency bias repair, raw-budget noninferiority gates, and explicit abstention before a fresh-seed claim

data_contract.source: recursively verified completed MV9 output root and task artifacts
data_contract.training: MV9 development train_x and cross-seed train_y only
data_contract.selection: MV9 development validation_x and validation_y only
data_contract.legacy_diagnostic: previously observed MV9 evaluation arrays, read only in aggregate postprocessing

training_contract.prediction: bounded qy-only residual correction to Raw DSMC B1
training_contract.backbone: 32-channel dilated local residual trunk plus an 8-cell average-pooled coarse branch and an adaptive global-mean branch
training_contract.loss: linear boundary-weighted pixel MSE plus low-pass MSE plus global-mean MSE plus gradient MSE
training_contract.reason: the MV9 failure was a coherent amplitude and low-frequency bias in qy; the added terms target that diagnosed mode while a deterministic bounded residual prevents unconstrained field synthesis

selection_contract.ensemble: arithmetic mean of all three independently initialized accepted tasks

analysis_contract.classification: legacy diagnostic thresholds for authorizing fresh-seed confirmation, not hypothesis-test acceptance thresholds
analysis_contract.authorization_rule: all listed legacy diagnostic gates must pass before writing a separate fresh-seed confirmatory protocol
analysis_contract.passing_interpretation: method is sufficiently promising to justify fresh unobserved DSMC seeds; no confirmatory claim yet
analysis_contract.failure_interpretation: do not spend a new confirmatory budget on this qy method without a newly disclosed redesign

figure_contract.upper_row: physical qy with one shared signed blue-white-red scale
figure_contract.lower_row: signed error as percent of fixed q_ref, never local percent error
